The title is the chip: U5 a link
Board on it); "Zoom to" is gone
Counter bits 16–19: counts when U4 carries;
Its role, from the Service Manual:
Pin names in mono next to the body;
Nets in italic blue, further out
○ at the body active low (_N kept)
RCO, QA, QB, QC go nowhere: dashed
LOAD_N and ENP are tied to VCC:
black, not grey (grey is the kind,
No folds: the pinout, Function and
A counter that steps 0, 1, 2, … 15, 0 on each
rising edge of CLK. Its value appears on QA
Each output runs at half the frequency of the one
before: with a 1 MHz clock, QA is 500 kHz, QB
The sheet's pin names, dotted: hover
lights the pad (and its Net) on the
Board and the row above; a click
On each rising clock edge, in this order of priority:
CLR_N low: the count is 0 at once
LOAD_N low: the count becomes A–D
ENP and ENT both high: up by one
CLK: clock; the count changes on its rising edge
LOAD_N: load A–D on the next clock, active low
ENP, ENT: count enables; both high to count
QA–QD: the count, QA lowest bit
RCO: ripple carry out, high at count 15
